# eslint-typescript-access

> An ESLint plugin that enforces explicit access modifiers and accessibility ordering on TypeScript class members.

This plugin provides two ESLint rules for TypeScript projects: one that requires explicit `public`, `protected`, or `private` modifiers on all class members, and another that enforces member ordering by visibility level. It eliminates ambiguity about whether a member is public intentionally or by accident, prevents API surface creep, and makes classes easier to navigate. Built for ESLint 9 flat config with recommended and strict presets.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://quinnjr.github.io/eslint-typescript-access/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/quinnjr/eslint-typescript-access)
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/eslint-typescript-access)

## Key Features

- Require explicit access modifiers (`public`, `protected`, `private`) on all class members
- Enforce member ordering by visibility (public -> protected -> private, or custom order)
- Per-member-type overrides (constructors, methods, properties, parameter properties, accessors)
- Optional `groupByKind` mode to check ordering within each member kind separately
- Built for ESLint 9 flat config with first-class support
- Includes `recommended` and `strict` preset configurations
- Highly configurable with `no-public` mode to disallow explicit `public`

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add -D eslint-typescript-access
# or
npm install -D eslint-typescript-access
```

## Quick Start

```js
// eslint.config.js
import tsAccessPlugin from "eslint-typescript-access";

export default [
  // Use the recommended preset
  tsAccessPlugin.configs.recommended,
];
```
